_doc: Machine-readable aggressive representation search space (ODYSSEY_POLICY.aggressive_ladder.search_space_is_data). tools/odyssey_candgen.py expands the grid, applies native/disk/mem/source-pass constraints, and ranks by expected info-gain/cost. No per-candidate LLM.
_evidence: HYPOTHESIS (Doctor-risk priors); native-availability INFERRED from mlx_lm affine-grouped; complete_bpw DERIVED (payload + f16 scale/bias per group + correction + metadata codec)

spec_grammar._doc: Runner --gravity spec strings. Canonical emission omits default suffixes (router=4, meta=raw, correction=0). Parser accepts any suffix order.

native_availability._evidence: INFERRED (mlx_lm.convert bits={2,3,4,8} group={32,64,128}; mixed via per-module quant_predicate). 1-bit, shared/entropy metadata, correction planes, matryoshka tiers, and scale-joint r-search are non-native (Hawking kernel / STRUCTURAL).

constraint_defaults._mem_budget_note: 0.85 * 96 GiB M3 Ultra (bible §33); generate() may override from policy

families.mechanism: Hold the affine grouped codec fixed and vary group size (and modest bit width). Metadata cost is 16+16 bits per group; group-32 vs group-128 is a complete-bpw / Doctor trade, not a new family.
families.cheapest_falsifier: fast-Doctor q3-g32 vs q3-g128 (or q4-g64 vs q4-g32) at counted complete_bpw; if Doctor-equal, smaller groups only buy metadata and lose.
families.expected_win: A conventional CONVENTIONAL_ANCHOR (q4-g64 / q3-g32-experts / q4-g64-attn-mlp) plus a cheap group-size discriminator.

families.mechanism: Per-expert (MoE) mixed affine quant: experts at bit_class/group, attention protected, router_precision independent, optional sparse correction budget, metadata codec (raw / shared-across-experts / entropy-coded scales).
families.cheapest_falsifier: fast-Doctor q2-g32-experts vs q3-g32-experts; if q2 delta_hits <= -2, do not globally retreat — localize (router / organ / expert) and keep searching allocation.
families.expected_win: Sub-3 complete_bpw on the expert body without a uniform-q2 Doctor collapse; active-bytes follow the selected-expert fraction, not stored density.

families.mechanism: q{lo} base with sensitivity-driven promotion to q{hi} on the worst per-organ (and, when present, per-expert) Doctor-delta components. Reuses representation.per_organ_sensitivity; records protected organs. Not ordinary mixed-precision.
families.cheapest_falsifier: mixed-q2q3-experts vs uniform q2-g32-experts on the same fast-Doctor battery; if mixed does not beat uniform-q2, sensitivity is not an allocation lever on this patient.
families.expected_win: A q2-class stored density with Doctor restored by protecting a small sensitive subset (router / attn / gate) instead of a global bit retreat.

families.mechanism: Cheap affine base + sparse/residual/selected-hi-prec correction plane (bible §58/§92). Correction budget is a fraction of weights stored at repair precision; topology (scattered/row/block) is the cheapest-falsifier, not the bit width.
families.cheapest_falsifier: q2+correction vs plain q2 at matched complete_bpw (correction bytes counted). If Doctor does not recover, the topology is wrong — raise budget only after a topology miss, never as a global retreat.
families.expected_win: Doctor restoration at << +1 nominal bit, lowering active cost without a complete stored sub-1 body.

families.mechanism: Jointly search group-scale ratio r (absmax r=1, MSE r<1, overscale r>1) against the codec at fixed CODED bits — not absmax or MSE as a codec-blind sidecar. Emits one spec per (bits, group); the r-grid is the family's internal search.
families.cheapest_falsifier: r=1 (absmax) vs a 3-point r-grid at matched coded bits on one sensitive organ; if the Pareto is r=1, joint opt is dead for this codec on this patient.
families.expected_win: Same nominal bits, lower complete_bpw via concentrated codes and/or a Doctor gain from a non-absmax scale, counted in complete_bpw.

families.mechanism: Nested fidelity tiers T0..T3 (bible §58): cheap base + correction-1 + correction-2 + exact/rare repair. Active path may stop at T0/T1; stored body carries the unused tiers. Counts stored tiers, active tiers, hit rate.
families.cheapest_falsifier: Decode T0-only vs T0+T1 on the fast-Doctor battery; if T1 never hits (or never restores Doctor), drop the extra stored tier.
families.expected_win: Conditional fidelity: low active-bytes/token with an on-demand repair tier, distinct from a single-shot mixed quant.
